The prefix has length $m-1$ and must cover $100-m$ distinct values, so $m-1\ge100-m$, i.e. $m\ge51$. For a given $m$, the minimal prefix consists of a plateau of $p=2m-100$ copies of $m$ followed by a single climb $m+1,m+2,\dots,99$. This gives total sum
